message.content: Based on the conversation between WolfgangSchulz and LiHua, LiHua mentions that she has heard the seafood in Cinque Terre is described as "supposed to be fresh and delicious." However, she hasn't personally visited the area herself and hasn't tried the local dishes there. WolfgangSchulz, who has been to Cinque Terre, particularly enjoys the seafood risotto he had during his visit to Venice. While LiHua expresses enthusiasm about the possibility of trying the seafood in Cinque Terre, she doesn't provide any personal experience or opinion regarding the freshness or quality of the seafood in the region.
